items.title: 60499_Garvin Bushell oral history interview
items.q: And Freddy Tousell and Willy Gant and Fats. Fats was a youngster but he could still stride...

ctx.x: And Freddy Tousell and Willy Gant and Fats. Fats was a youngster but he could still stride, but he was no match for James P. and Willie "The Lion". They'd

meet down at Leroy's, say on a Saturday night and it would last three and four hours, and it always ended up with James P. on top but Willie "The Lion" it was a toss-up, but James P. had a little more knowledge. But they were sensational -- to hear those guys play.
